title: Request a market read | Nazryx
description: Send your product list and target markets. Nazryx will show you what is open, thin or crowded for your products.

sections.title: Send your product list.
sections.lede: Tell us who you are, what you make and which markets interest you. We reply within one working day. Prefer to talk first? Book twenty minutes.

side.title: What happens next
rows: We reply within one working day
A proposal, if the market is open

items.title: We reply
items.text: With questions, or a time for a short call.

items.title: A short call
items.text: Twenty minutes on your portfolio and certificates.

items.title: Your market read
items.text: What is open, thin or crowded, per market.

items.title: Your list stays private
items.text: Used to read the market for you and nothing else.

items.title: No obligation
items.text: You see the evidence before anything is agreed.

items.title: Registrations stay yours
items.text: If you go ahead, everything is filed in your name.

sections.title: Prefer to talk first?
sections.text: Call, WhatsApp or book twenty minutes.
